name: jira_search
description: Search for issues using a JQL-style text query matched against issue summary and description, with optional project, status, and assignee filters (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql)

jql.description: The JQL-style search text. Matched case-insensitively as a substring of the issue summary or description.

project.description: Restrict results to issues in the project with this project key, for example RECON.

status.description: Restrict results to issues currently in this status, for example In Progress.

assignee.description: Restrict results to issues assigned to this user. Accepts the display name or the email address.

max_results.description: The maximum number of issues to return per page. Default: 50.

start_at.description: The index of the first issue to return (0-based). Default: 0.
